writer.output-contract: Output ONLY JSON: { "markdown": "<doc body>", "citations": [{"kind": "endpoint"|"route"|"table"|"column"|"role"|"file", "ref": "<concrete identifier from inputs>"}], "inferred_fields": ["<short phrase for each value you marked (inferred)>"], "gaps": ["<short phrase per input element that was missing>"] }. The citations / inferred_fields / gaps arrays may be empty but the keys MUST be present. Do not invent endpoints, routes, tables, columns, edges, roles, or files not present in the inputs. Mark any value not directly supported by the inputs as "(inferred)" inline in the markdown AND list it in inferred_fields. When the inputs are silent on a section, write a short "Gaps" note in the markdown AND list the missing element in gaps. Do not write the response as anything other than the specified JSON object.
